# ten4seven UI agent index

## Start here

- `AGENTS.md` — short root rules and retrieval order.
- `docs/ai/AI_QUICKSTART.md` — two-minute system orientation.
- `docs/ai/APPLY_TO_EXISTING_WEB.md` — business-logic-safe migration workflow.
- `docs/ai/NEW_PROJECT.md` — greenfield sequence.
- `docs/ai/COMPONENT_SELECTION.md` — high-frequency component decisions.
- `docs/ai/THEMING.md` — public provider and typography contract.
- `skills/ten4seven-ui/SKILL.md` — reusable agent workflow.

## FOUNDATIONS

- `packages/tokens/src/theme.ts` — axes, semantic typography roles, and variable generation.
- `packages/tokens/src/theme.css` — local Inter variable font and global token CSS.
- `packages/ui/src/provider.tsx` — provider and runtime theme propagation.
- `packages/ui/src/components.tsx` — canonical React primitives.
- `packages/icons/src/index.tsx` — local semantic icon boundary.

## AI CATALOGS

- `packages/ai/catalog/recipes.json` — page archetypes and component composition.
- `packages/ai/catalog/components.json` — searchable component contracts.
- `packages/ai/catalog/icons.json` — semantic icon lookup; provider names are implementation detail.
- `packages/ai/templates/AGENTS.ten4seven.md` — copy into consuming repositories.

## RECIPES

- dashboard
- entity-list
- entity-detail
- entity-form
- master-detail
- approval-queue
- settings
- report
- catalog
- product-detail
- checkout
- content-list
- content-detail
- ebook-reader
- auth
- marketing-home

## COMPONENTS

- forms: `Input`, `Select`, `FormSection`
- layout/navigation: `AppShell`, `Sidebar`, `NavItem`, `PageHeader`
- surfaces: `Card`, `Badge`, `Typography`
- data: `DataTable`, `FilterToolbar`, `Pagination`, `KPICluster`, `EmptyState`
- overlays: `Modal`, `DetailDrawer`, `Drawer`
- catalog: `ProductCard`
- actions: `Button`, `BulkActionBar`, `ActionFooter`

## CLI

- `pnpm t7ui info`
- `pnpm t7ui find "inventory list"`
- `pnpm t7ui show DataTable`
- `pnpm t7ui agents init`

## REFERENCE ROUTES

- Theme Studio: `http://localhost:4173/theme-studio`
- Warehouse Inventory: `http://localhost:4173/warehouse-inventory`
- Ebook Store Catalog: `http://localhost:4173/ebook-store`

Open these deterministic URLs directly for refresh-safe AI-agent and Playwright QA.
